ARURCOHE trains architects and engineers in the rehabilitation of architectural and urban heritage, combining conservation technology with regeneration policy across an Erasmus Mundus consortium. The programme site publishes the current call, scholarship information and mobility structure.

Programme Highlights

  • Heritage-rehabilitation specialisation spanning architecture and planning
  • Studio and fieldwork in European historic urban contexts
  • Call-specific deadlines on the official site
  • Careers in conservation practice, urban regeneration agencies and research

Who Should Apply

Architecture, civil engineering, urban planning and conservation graduates are the natural applicants, with portfolio elements usually required.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students per the live call.

Deadline and How to Apply

Follow the ARURCOHE site for the live call and prepare the portfolio and documents listed there. Key deadline information: Current call and closing date published on the official programme site.
